Generate a storyboard and prompts from a scene or reference images, confirm the script with the user, then optionally submit multi-segment video generation tasks to the Volcengine Ark video API. Use when the user wants to turn a scene idea into a structured video workflow, especially for mood films, product scenes, narrative shorts, or image-to-video prompt pipelines.
